transcript_text:
[00:04] 5986043618575841749: hey, thanks for making the time. can you hear me okay?
[00:34] 1136117155107563376: yep all good. what time is it there for you? it's morning here.
[01:04] 5986043618575841749: perfect. so I'd love to hear what's going on on your side and what made you take the call. I know you're over in Canada.
[01:45] 1136117155107563376: sure. so we're Foundry42, we're in the saas space. and yeah, our new VP of Engineering came in and wants observability sorted in the first quarter.
[02:36] 1136117155107563376: at our log volume the current tool just falls over, queries time out constantly.
[03:26] 5986043618575841749: that's a really common story. what are you using today?
[03:54] 1136117155107563376: right now it's mostly Datazen. and the bill has completely gotten away from us, it doubled year over year and nobody can predict it.
[05:09] 1136117155107563376: we've also looked at Newforge a bit.
[05:54] 5986043618575841749: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[06:12] 1136117155107563376: we've got a SOC 2 audit coming and we need longer log retention than we currently keep.
[06:42] 5986043618575841749: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[07:21] 1136117155107563376: honestly the biggest driver is cost, we're paying for three tools and the finance team is asking hard questions.
[07:41] 5986043618575841749: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[08:20] 1136117155107563376: when something breaks at 2am it takes us forever to even figure out which service is the problem.
[08:56] 5986043618575841749: got it. and is that something you're actively trying to fix?
[09:40] 1136117155107563376: we have zero visibility into what the actual user experience looks like in the browser.
[10:18] 1136117155107563376: our monitoring bill is now our second biggest cloud line item and it's totally unpredictable.
[11:05] 5986043618575841749: makes sense. when you picture this working well, what does that look like?
[12:04] 1136117155107563376: the single-pane thing is really appealing, we're tired of jumping between tools.
[13:10] 5986043618575841749: and what would hold you back from moving on this?
[14:00] 1136117155107563376: my worry is migration, we've got years of dashboards and runbooks built on the current tool.
[15:02] 1136117155107563376: everyone's trained on the existing dashboards, there's a lot of muscle memory.
[16:07] 5986043618575841749: totally fair. let me show you how a couple of teams like yours handled exactly that.
[16:53] 1136117155107563376: yeah that'd be helpful. timeline-wise we're not in a huge rush but it's on the roadmap.
[17:22] 5986043618575841749: great — here's what I'd suggest as a next step.
[17:49] 1136117155107563376: works for me.
